findings.summary: An empty --profile now falls back to E_AGENT_PROFILE without saying so; before the change an empty path failed. Testing `path is None` instead of truthiness would refuse the empty string.
README and the runbook export a relative E_AGENT_PROFILE; from any other directory every profile-loading command fails with a FileNotFoundError traceback.

The implicit-default scan matches only the literal `load_profile()`; load_profile(None) and CLI invocations without --profile are outside it (checked by hand: all callers pass a profile). It scans 183 files at HEAD; the handoff said 184.
The red run was an ImportError at collection, not the behavioural red the plan expected; test_load_profile_requires_path_or_env never ran against the old default (it would have failed).

Running scripts/dev/serve.py directly, without make, used to start on the packaged fixture profile and now fails with STARTUP_REJECTED; the documented make targets always export E_AGENT_DEV_PROFILE. Handoff ruling 3 does not mention this.
